verdict.rationale: Blaxel sandboxes support code execution: you run shell commands as processes, retrieve their output logs in batch or as a stream, and build images with pre-configured languages, so multiple runtimes are reachable through custom images and shell commands. There is no evidence of a native multi-language code-interpreter API or of rich result types beyond process logs. missing for 10: a documented first-class per-language execution API (Python/JS and more), rich structured results (charts, dataframes, typed outputs) rather than plain logs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute code in multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, and more) and get rich results back

citations.quote: Execute and manage processes in your sandboxes with Blaxel SDK. Run shell commands, retrieve process information, and control process execution.
Retrieve process output logs from sandboxes in batch or real-time streaming mode using the Blaxel SDK in TypeScript, Python, or Go.
Create reusable sandbox images with pre-configured tools, languages, and frameworks using Dockerfiles.
